HelpCopiesPlayedStateProgress: Copies played state, progress, play count, last played date, and favorites.
HelpCopiesPostersBackdropsLogos: Copies posters, backdrops, logos, and more.
HelpCopiesSubtitleAudioDisplay: Copies subtitle, audio, and display preferences.
HelpCopiesTitleOverviewRatings: Copies the title, overview, ratings, dates, and ids.
HelpCopiesTitlesDescriptionsRatings: Copies titles, descriptions, ratings, and images.
HelpCopiesWasLastPlayed: Copies when it was last played.
HelpCopiesWhetherFavorite: Copies whether it is a favorite.
HelpCopiesWhetherItemPlayed: Copies whether an item is played.
HelpCopiesWhoAppearsItem: Copies who appears in each item. Can be slow.
HelpCountOwnPlayback: Counts a user's own playback here toward the limit on their user mapping.
HelpDecidesUsersPermissionsBoth: Decides a user's permissions when both servers changed them. Other server takes theirs, Permissive allows the most, and Restrictive allows the least.
HelpDecidesWhatHappensCopy: Decides what happens to a copy when its source deletes the playlist.
HelpDecidesWhichFileDropped: Decides which file is dropped first when the cache is full.
HelpDecidesWhichServerSpeaks: Decides which server speaks for an item that several servers hold. Ranked follows the Servers tab order.
HelpDownloadSyncedFileAgain: Download a synced file again when it is missing here or its size differs from the source's.
HelpExternalUrl: Sets the URL a browser uses for that server, when it differs. Empty uses the Server URL.
HelpFilterMode: Allow all syncs everything. Whitelist syncs only what is picked. Blacklist syncs everything but what is picked.
HelpGiveLinksTrickplayChapter: Give links the trickplay and chapter images their source made. Jellyfin makes neither for a link.
HelpHintsAccepted: Hints a server accepted and is still working on.
HelpHintsGathering: Local changes waiting out Send changes after.
HelpHintsMalformed: Hints a server refused as malformed.
HelpHintsReceived: Hints received from servers and not yet applied.
HelpHintsWaiting: Hints waiting to be sent to a server.
HelpHonorBitrateLimit: Links are never transcoded here. A version above the user's Maximum remote streaming bitrate is refused, so they get a smaller version when the film has one.
HelpIgnoreKeepsFilesHides: Ignore keeps the files and hides an emptied movie or show folder with a .ignore file. Uncertain deletions always wait for approval.
HelpJoinsOverlappingSegmentsSame: Joins overlapping segments of the same type, other than intros and outros, into one that covers both, so 1:00 to 1:30 and 1:05 to 1:45 become 1:00 to 1:45.
HelpKeepsFileBinMany: Keeps a file in the bin this many days before it is deleted. 1 to 365.
HelpKeepsFileManyDays: Keeps a file this many days after it was last played, or after it was cached if never played. 0 keeps files until the space is needed.
HelpKeepsFilesServersyncLinks: Keeps files in a serversync-links folder here. Empty uses Jellyfin's cache folder. Changing it empties the old location.
HelpKeepsLocalCopiesPlayed: Keeps local copies of played links and upcoming episodes, which play from here even while the source is down. Each library can opt out on the Storage tab.
HelpKeepsMuchSpaceFree: Keeps this much space free on the library's disk. A file that would leave less is not downloaded.
HelpKeptOwn: On this server before it was matched to that server's file. It stays when that server removes its file.
HelpKeptPick: Copied because of an Always keep pick.
HelpKeptUnknown: A copy from before Server Sync recorded why it is a copy.
HelpLetsJellyfinsMediaSegment: Lets Jellyfin's media segment scan copy intros, credits, and other segments from the same file on the servers this one pulls from.
HelpLetsLibraryFillItems: Lets a library fill items from the servers this one pulls from, where Server Sync is on in its metadata or image fetchers.
HelpLetsLibraryFillPeople: Lets a library fill people from the servers this one pulls from, where Server Sync is on in its metadata or image fetchers.
HelpLibrariesLocked: Test the connection in step 2 to load libraries.
HelpLibraryMappings: Map that server's libraries to local ones. Storage, Always keep, and filters are on the Storage tab.
HelpLimitedNeedsUserServers: Limited needs the user on that server's whitelist.
HelpLimitsWhoMayCall: Limits who may call this server's sync routes. An administrator or API Key calling from an enabled server's address always may.
HelpLinkMaxStreams: Sets the most streams that server may run at once. 0 is no limit.
HelpLocalPathPending: The file will be synced to this location.
HelpModePull: Read from this server on a schedule.
HelpModePush: Send changes made here as they happen. Needs Server Sync there.
HelpModeSync: Pull and Push together. Needs Server Sync there set to Sync.
HelpMoveDeletedReplacedFiles: Move deleted and replaced files to a bin instead of deleting them.
HelpNegotiateHistory: Write merged watch history back to that server too.
HelpPermanentCopies: Lists the full copies in this server's Link libraries. Turning one back into a link moves the copy into the link cache.
HelpRecreateCollectionsWhitelistedLibrar: Recreate collections whitelisted in a library filter on the Storage tab, with their synced items.
HelpRemoveFoldersLeftEmpty: Remove folders left empty after a delete.
HelpRemovesSegmentsServerSync: Removes the segments Server Sync copied to a file when no server this one pulls from has any for it. Segments another provider made here are never removed.
HelpReplacesSegmentsAnotherProvider: Replaces the segments another provider gave a file with the ones copied from a server, type by type.
HelpResetsForgetTrackingOnly: Resets forget tracking only. Media is untouched.
HelpServerEnabled: Keeps the settings and skips this server while off.
HelpServerName: Names the server in tables and logs. Empty uses the server's own name.
HelpServerRank: Ranks servers from the top down. Drag a server to move it.
HelpServerUrl: Sets the URL this server uses to reach that one, such as http://server:8096.
HelpSetStreamSpeedsAbove: Set stream speeds above your files' bitrate, or playback buffers. 0 is no limit, and a user mapping can set a lower one.
HelpSetsFolderBin: Sets the folder for the bin.
HelpSetsHowFastFiles: Sets how fast files move to this server and to each server allowed to link.
HelpSetsHowManyFiles: Sets how many files download at the same time. 1 to 10.
HelpSetsHowManyMetadata: Sets how many Metadata and People items refresh at once, and how many requests a Metadata scan sends to a server at once. Lower it when a server is slow.
HelpSetsHowMuchWork: Sets how much work runs at once and how fast changes are sent.
HelpSetsMostDiskCache: Sets the most disk the cache may use, across all servers. Available space is what the cache holds plus what is free on its disk, less Minimum free space. Off empties the cache.
HelpSetsShareAvailableSpace: Sets the share of the available space the cache may use. 1 to 100.
HelpSetsTriesFailedDownload: Sets the tries for a failed download or item within one run. One that still fails is tried again on the next run. 1 to 10.
HelpSetsWhereDownloadsWait: Sets where downloads wait before they move into place. Empty uses a serversync folder in Jellyfin's cache folder.
HelpSettingsIntro: Sets how this server sends changes and who may call it. Each section saves on its own.
HelpShrinksIntrosOverlapPart: Shrinks intros that overlap to the part they share, so 0:00 to 0:30 and 0:05 to 0:45 become 0:05 to 0:30.
HelpShrinksOutrosOverlapPart: Shrinks outros that overlap to the part they share, the same way as intros.
HelpSignedUsersNeedAllow: Signed in users need Allow media downloading. Limited live changes need the user on that server's whitelist.
HelpSkipItemsPickedUser: Skip items every picked user has watched. None picked syncs everything.
HelpStorage: Sets how each mapped library keeps its files, and which items it syncs. Libraries are mapped on the Servers tab.
HelpStorageLibraries: Shows one card for each enabled library mapping of this server.
HelpStorageMode: Copy downloads each file and follows that server, so a file it removes is handled by Removed files here. Link writes a .strm that streams from any server that holds the file and allows linking, and goes only when none holds it.
HelpStreamLinksDirectPlay: Stream a link's direct play from its source per user, so two viewers are counted apart. Turn off if a player cannot direct play links.
HelpStreamsFilmHighestRanked: Streams a film from the highest ranked server that is idle for this server, or else the one with the most streams free. 0 is no limit.
HelpSynchronizationIntro: Sets what each sync type copies and who can use it.
HelpTestForAccess: Test the connection to see what this key can do.
HelpUnkeepPicked: Copies covered by an Always keep pick stay copies. Remove the pick under Always keep on this tab instead.
HelpUnmappedUsers: Sets who streams for a user on that server with no user mapping here.
HelpUseOtherSpeedsDuring: Use other speeds during set hours.
HelpUserLinkMaxStreams: Sets the most streams the local user may hold at once for that server's links. Empty or 0 uses the server's limit.
HelpUserLinkSpeed: Sets the fastest each stream and cache download for this user is sent, never above the server's speed. Empty or 0 uses the server's speed.
HelpUserMappings: Map that server's users to local ones. With Allow linking on, each mapping can also cap the local user's link streams and speed.
HelpUsersLocked: Test the connection in step 2 to load users.
